xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3745: cost.recorded events rejected by DomainEvent schema at the ws-rpc boundary (log spam; decide broadcast vs filter)

plan.title: cost.recorded events rejected by DomainEvent schema at the ws-rpc boundary (log spam; decide broadcast vs filter)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The cost write door (src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts:591) emits 'cost.recorded' with payload { issueId, cost }, but the contracts DomainEvent union only knows 'cost.event_recorded' with payload { agentId, issueId, workspaceId?, cost, inputTokens, outputTokens }. The PAN-2225 boundary guard in ws-rpc.ts drops and logs every door-recorded cost event, so cost-reconcile sweeps spam the dashboard log and God View live cost counters never see door-recorded costs.
narratives.Proposal: Align the emitter with the existing contract: record() announces 'cost.event_recorded' with the full contract payload when both agentId and issueId are non-null, and skips the announcement otherwise. Extend the existing cost.test.ts suite to prove the payload decodes through the contracts CostEventRecordedEvent schema and that unattributed records emit nothing. Document the announcement in docs/cost-tracking.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not add 'cost.recorded' to the contracts DomainEvent union
- Do not change shouldBroadcastDashboardEvent in agent-output-stream.ts
- Do not modify the agent-event-utils.ts cost-event translator or any consumer (God View confluence, motionCatalog, read model)
- No consumer-side dedupe of door-vs-translator duplicate announcements (windowed cosmetic counters only; durable totals are DB-backed)
- No changes to cost dedup, JSONL archive, or reconcile sweep logic
- Do not edit docs/TELEMETRY.md (anonymous-telemetry doc, no cost door section) or docs/GOD-VIEW.md (never names the event literal)

autoDecisions.summary: Rename the emitter to 'cost.event_recorded' rather than adding 'cost.recorded' to the union or filtering it in shouldBroadcastDashboardEvent
autoDecisions.rationale: The canonical PRD (drafts/pan-3745.md on overdeck-state, authored by conv-20260816-9367) already decided this and planning re-verified it: the union member and every consumer already use 'cost.event_recorded', adding a second name for one concept violates one-term-per-concept, and filtering would keep God View live counters permanently blind to door-recorded costs.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend tests/unit/lib/overdeck/cost.test.ts instead of creating a new cost-announce.test.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The suite already covers record()'s announcement (assertion at line ~370 expects the old name), so the PRD's conditional new-file clause does not apply; the stale assertion flips in the same commit as the emitter change to keep the tree green.

autoDecisions.summary: Doc target is docs/cost-tracking.md, not docs/TELEMETRY.md; docs/GOD-VIEW.md is unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified by grep on 2026-08-16: TELEMETRY.md documents anonymous usage telemetry only and has no cost write door section; GOD-VIEW.md never names the event literal, only 'cost pulses'.
CostEvent has no workspaceId field and the contract marks workspaceId optional; inventing a placeholder would fabricate attribution.

items.title: Align cost door announcement to the cost.event_recorded contract

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts, inside record() at step 3 (line ~591), replace the emit of type 'cost.recorded' with a guarded emit of type 'cost.event_recorded' carrying the full contract payload: agentId, issueId, cost, inputTokens set from event.input, outputTokens set from event.output. Emit only when both event.agentId and event.issueId are non-null (both are Schema.NullOr on CostEvent); otherwise skip the announcement entirely. No cast is needed — bus.emit takes OverdeckEventInput whose type is a plain string, and the event store stamps sequence/timestamp before the ws-rpc guard re-validates. Replace the stale comment 'Announce — cost.subscribe + /api/costs/stream feed from this.' with one naming the real consumers (e.g. 'Announce on the canonical contract type — God View live counters feed from this.'). In the same commit, flip the stale assertion in tests/unit/lib/overdeck/cost.test.ts (line ~370) from expecting 'cost.recorded' to expecting 'cost.event_recorded' so the existing suite stays green. Exact before/after snippet is work item 1 in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-3745.md).

items.title: Given an attributed CostEvent (non-null agentId and issueId), when record() persists it, then it emits exactly one bus event of type 'cost.event_recorded' whose payload contains agentId, issueId, cost, inputTokens equal to event.input, and outputTokens equal to event.output
Given a CostEvent with null agentId or null issueId, when record() persists it, then it emits zero bus events
grep -n 'cost\.recorded' src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts produces no output — the old event literal and the stale cost.subscribe comment are gone
npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/overdeck/cost.test.ts exits 0 with the flipped announcement assertion expecting 'cost.event_recorded'
Add schema-decode and attribution-guard tests for the cost announcement

expected_outputs: cost.test.ts suite exits 0 including the new announcement tests

narrative.Action: Extend tests/unit/lib/overdeck/cost.test.ts (the suite already captures emitted bus events for the existing announcement assertion). Add three tests: (1) recording an attributed event emits one 'cost.event_recorded' whose payload validates through the contracts CostEventRecordedEvent payload struct from packages/contracts/src/events.ts — decode the payload only (sequence/timestamp are store-stamped), using Schema.decodeUnknownSync as in packages/contracts/src/events.test.ts; this decode is the mechanical guarantee the ws-rpc boundary guard passes the event. (2) Recording an event with null agentId produces zero emitted bus events. (3) Recording an event with null issueId produces zero emitted bus events. Follow the suite's existing pattern for capturing bus emissions; do not create a new test file.
